'''Yit Fun Yap Analog Bubblebath''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Yit Fun Yap]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10302">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10302 Analog Bubblebath], DeckTech (Yit Fun "turboinsan" Yap, 8 September 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10302/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10302/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018125130/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10302/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Yit Fun Yap]]
* '''Published:''' 8 September 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Analog Bubblebath''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 SYCFA Yap DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Techy, unstable ground pound deck. Flows smoothly, hence the title.
